title: Do not add a CMS: Keystatic was discarded and Sanity postponed because content outside git skips the gates
body: Evaluated 2026-08-25 under the free-stack constraint. Keystatic: discarded — it needs an Astro SSR adapter plus React and Markdoc, in a repo built on `output: static` and a tiny critical JS budget. Sanity: viable (free tier is ample) but postponed; its model already changed twice (2023, 2025), and decisively, with data outside git it stops passing through the gates — validate, rules 7/8 and test:pdf run on push, not on a webhook, so a badly loaded achievement would publish unchecked. The real friction (a typo costs PRs) is not fixed by a CMS, only sidestepped by skipping gates. Chosen instead: the local editor (`pnpm run editor`), kept outside src/pages. Editing from a phone was deliberately discarded with it. Adopting Sanity later costs the same: write `sanity-source.ts` and change one line in content/source/index.ts.
not_derivable: The CMS evaluation and the 'gates run on push' argument are not in code; only the resulting seam is.

evidence.summary: Local editor, outside src/pages to avoid an SSR adapter.
